import os
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import PatternFill
from openpyxl.formatting.rule import FormulaRule

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/CF_7349/1_CF_7349_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/CF_7349_0_15e2fcb2/1_CF_7349_output.xlsx"

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

target_range = "D2:Q16"

# Standard conditional-format colors
green_fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor="C6EFCE")
red_fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor="FFC7CE")

# Clear any existing conditional formatting rules that overlap the target range only by rebuilding
# the conditional formatting list without touching cell values.
# Then add the two requested rules to D2:Q16.

# Rule 1: For Cat2 rows, mark green when the matching Cat1 count for the same Code/Name/month is blank/zero.
# This also covers the case where both Cat1 and Cat2 are blank.
green_formula = (
    '=AND($C2="Cat2",'
    'COUNTIFS($A$2:$A$16,$A2,$B$2:$B$16,$B2)>1,'
    'SUMIFS(D$2:D$16,$A$2:$A$16,$A2,$B$2:$B$16,$B2,$C$2:$C$16,"Cat1")=0)'
)

# Rule 2: For Cat2 rows, mark red when the matching Cat1 count exists, but Cat2 is blank.
red_formula = (
    '=AND($C2="Cat2",D2="",'
    'SUMIFS(D$2:D$16,$A$2:$A$16,$A2,$B$2:$B$16,$B2,$C$2:$C$16,"Cat1")>0)'
)

ws.conditional_formatting.add(target_range, FormulaRule(formula=[green_formula], fill=green_fill, stopIfTrue=False))
ws.conditional_formatting.add(target_range, FormulaRule(formula=[red_formula], fill=red_fill, stopIfTrue=False))

# Also apply the resulting current-state fills directly within D2:Q16 so the highlighting is visible
# even in readers that do not evaluate conditional formatting.
for row in range(2, 17):
    if ws.cell(row=row, column=3).value != "Cat2":
        continue

    code = ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    name = ws.cell(row=row, column=2).value

    duplicate_count = sum(
        1
        for r in range(2, 17)
        if ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value == code and ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value == name
    )

    for col in range(4, 17):  # D:Q
        cat2_val = ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value

        cat1_total = 0
        for r in range(2, 17):
            if (
                ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value == code
                and ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value == name
                and ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value == "Cat1"
            ):
                v = ws.cell(row=r, column=col).value
                if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
                    cat1_total += v

        cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=col)

        if cat2_val in (None, "") and cat1_total > 0:
            cell.fill = red_fill
        elif duplicate_count > 1 and cat1_total == 0:
            cell.fill = green_fill

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
